entries.title: What shinsal are
entries.content: Shinsal (신살, Chinese shen sha) are special 'stars' found by matching branches in a chart. They add color to a reading but never outweigh the five elements and Ten Gods.
entries.source: Master Sean Chan BaZi calculator; Four Pillars of Destiny - Wikipedia
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Peach Blossom (도화살)
entries.content: The charm and romance star. From your year or day animal: Monkey/Rat/Dragon → Rooster; Tiger/Horse/Dog → Rabbit; Snake/Rooster/Ox → Horse; Pig/Rabbit/Goat → Rat.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Travel Horse (역마살)
entries.content: The star of movement, travel and moving homes. Monkey/Rat/Dragon → Tiger; Tiger/Horse/Dog → Monkey; Snake/Rooster/Ox → Pig; Pig/Rabbit/Goat → Snake.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Nobleman (천을귀인)
entries.content: The helper star: people who show up when you need them. Found from your day stem: Gap/Mu/Gyeong → Ox or Goat; Eul/Gi → Rat or Monkey; Byeong/Jeong → Pig or Rooster; Im/Gye → Snake or Rabbit; Sin → Tiger or Horse.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Flower Canopy (화개살)
entries.content: The star of art, spirituality and solitude. Monkey/Rat/Dragon → Dragon; Tiger/Horse/Dog → Dog; Snake/Rooster/Ox → Ox; Pig/Rabbit/Goat → Goat.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Samjae (삼재)
entries.content: A traditional three-year 'careful' period by birth animal. Pig, Rabbit and Goat people are in their last Samjae year in 2027 (the Goat year). Koreans treat it as a time to be careful, not a curse.
